label: step-002
payload: Rename the three modules by writing a Python script called 'move_files.py' that uses shutil.move to rename 'one.py' to 'core_one.py', 'two.py' to 'core_two.py', and 'three.py' to 'core_three.py', then run it by executing it through the context-mode MCP sandbox (the ctx_execute / ctx_batch_execute tool), NOT the Bash tool. Perform the moves by writing and running that script — do NOT use your Edit/Write tools or a bash mv to move the files directly.
